g.text: When does a diagnosis become possible?

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59676b

g.text: Time thresholds for prolonged grief disorder

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24343a

g.text: These are not deadlines for grief.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59676b

g.text: Time alone is not enough: symptoms, impairment, and cultural context also matter.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59676b

g.text: *ICD-11 uses a six-month minimum; cultural expectations may require longer.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #236b70

g.text: Support can be sought before these thresholds.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59676b

g.text: Sources: WHO, ICD-11 (6B42); APA, Prolonged Grief Disorder (reviewed August 2025).
